user.title: Set up Snowfall
user.description: Add Snowfall to Home Assistant. You can configure the animation after setup.

init.title: Snowfall schedule
init.description: Choose when the snowfall effect should appear.

settings.title: Animation settings
settings.description: Customize the appearance and behavior of the snowflakes.

data_description.months: Choose the months when snowfall should be active.
data_description.excluded_paths: Enter one page path per line. Snowfall will be hidden on these pages. Leave empty to show snow everywhere.
data_description.flake_count: Controls the density of the snowfall.
data_description.size: Controls the size of individual snowflakes.
data_description.opacity: Controls how visible the snowflakes are.
